description: Three original, source-linked educational rules. Not a comprehensive trait or clinical interpretation database.

rules.title: Lactase persistence marker

explanations.AA: Two copies of the forward-strand A allele associated with adult lactase persistence in the studied European populations.
explanations.AG: One copy of the forward-strand A allele associated with adult lactase persistence in the studied European populations.
explanations.GG: The commonly studied European lactase-persistence allele is not present at this marker. This alone does not establish lactose intolerance.

rules.limits: Other lactase-persistence variants occur in other populations. Symptoms and lactose tolerance cannot be diagnosed from this marker. The paper's -13910 T allele corresponds to genomic forward A; the app does not infer strand flips.

rules.title: ALDH2 alcohol-metabolism marker

explanations.AA: Two copies of the low-activity ALDH2 allele are reported in this file. This variant is associated with impaired acetaldehyde processing and alcohol flushing.
explanations.AG: One copy of the low-activity ALDH2 allele is reported in this file. This variant is associated with impaired acetaldehyde processing and alcohol flushing.
explanations.GG: The rs671 low-activity A allele is not present. This does not establish normal alcohol metabolism or a safe alcohol intake.

rules.limits: Flushing is an imperfect proxy for genotype, and other genes and exposures matter. This is not a recommendation to drink or a quantified personal cancer-risk estimate.
rules.evidence: Functional variant with population-based cohort evidence

rules.title: Earwax-type marker

explanations.CC: This genotype is associated with wet earwax in the original ABCC11 study.
explanations.CT: This genotype is associated with wet earwax in the original ABCC11 study.
explanations.TT: This genotype is associated with dry earwax in the original ABCC11 study.

rules.limits: An association does not independently verify the measured trait or the raw call. The transcript G>A variant is C>T on the genomic forward strand; no ancestry or hygiene inference is made.
